name: @evie/desktop
description: The Evie desktop shell: a tray-resident macOS app that owns an Evie server and a window onto it.

scripts.build: bun run icons && bun run bundle
scripts.//dev: Adopts the server `turbo dev` starts rather than launching a rival: two servers on one EVIE_HOME fight over the same bot runtimes and the loser 401s forever. `app` is the standalone launcher, which starts its own server.
scripts.dev: bun run package && EVIE_ADOPT_WAIT_MS=30000 EVIE_HOME=../../.evie EVIE_ADOPT_WEB_URL=http://localhost:3000 ./out/Evie.app/Contents/MacOS/Evie
